RAF Fairford Incident: Suspects Known to US, Israeli Envoy Praises Indian Captain

An incident at RAF Fairford, a Royal Air Force base in Gloucestershire, England, led to a 'major incident' declaration and a road closure by armed police. Israeli Ambassador to India, Naor Gilon, stated that fighter jets were immediately scrambled in response to a flydubai emergency and praised the Indian captain of the flight. Separately, a farmer who called emergency services described himself as 'staggered'. Former US President Donald Trump commented that suspects involved in the Fairford incident were known to US authorities.
